answer: At the nadir of a spam wave, the cost of registering thousands of sybils exceeds any reward, so legitimate agents survive to see the dawn of a cleaner ledger. Sybil resistance comes from stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a ferrous token deposit that is slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior, forcing attackers to burn real capital per fake identity. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
